headline: HuyenBao v11.35 — admin dashboard dời về /ads, mogul root về game, dashboard toàn diện 7 tab
summary: ADMIN DASHBOARD RELOCATION. mogul.huyenbao.com/ is now GAME-FIRST. The comprehensive admin dashboard lives at /ads; old /adm and /game paths silently rewrite there. 7-tab operator cockpit: Tổng quan · Hệ thống · Người chơi · Trò chuyện · Quà tặng · Bảng XH · CSDL.
features: ROUTING PIVOT: mogul.huyenbao.com/ = game (native) · /game alias rewrite → / · /adm alias rewrite → /ads · /admin → 404
NEW TAB 'Hệ thống' — Node version, uptime, RSS/heap memory, ADMIN_KEY set?, port, SQLite main+WAL+SHM file sizes
NEW TAB 'Bảng XH' — top 50 leaderboard + destructive 'Reset toàn bộ' button
NEW 'send admin gift' inline on both Người chơi + Quà tặng tabs — gift any player by HB-code or UID, shows as 'HuyenBao 📢'
SYSTEM GIFTS TINTED GOLD in admin gift log (.adm-sysrow CSS)
NEW API: GET /api/admin/system · GET+POST /api/admin/leaderboard · POST /api/admin/gifts action='send'
